description: RESTL is the reservation system from St. Pölten built for Austrian hospitality. Search participating venues by place, cuisine and date, see real free time slots and book right in the chat. The booking lands instantly in the venue's system and you receive a confirmation email with a cancellation link. Existing bookings can be looked up or cancelled with the booking code plus the email address used. No account needed. The app never sees guest records or other guests' data; where a venue requires a card guarantee, that step happens only in the browser on restl.at, never in the chat.

defaultPrompt: Finde ein Restaurant in St. Pölten mit einem freien Tisch heute Abend für 2 Personen.
Reserviere mir für Samstagmittag einen Tisch für 6 Personen in einem Gasthaus in Niederösterreich.
